---
title: "Independent eQTL and DEG overlap summary"
## output: html_notebook
---

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(here)
})
here::i_am('.git/HEAD')

repo_root <- here()
ref_dir <- here("processed-data", "ref")
tqtl_in_dir <- here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "tqtl_in")
tqtl_out_dir <- here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "tqtl_out")
summary_dir <- file.path(tqtl_out_dir, "summary")
dir.create(summary_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load-manifest-and-degs}
manifest_file <- file.path(tqtl_in_dir, "prep_manifest.csv")
stopifnot(file.exists(manifest_file))

manifest <- fread(manifest_file)
manifest <- manifest[status == "prepared", .(dataset_id, context = seurat_label, split)]
manifest[, split := fifelse(split == "male", "male",
                     fifelse(split == "female", "female", "all"))]

source(here("code", "11_eQTL_coloc", "utils.R"), chdir = FALSE)
granges <- load_gene_ranges(repo_root = repo_root)
g2sym <- setNames(granges$gene_name, granges$gene_id)
sym2ensg <- setNames(granges$gene_id, granges$gene_name)

degs <- load_DEGs(repo_root = repo_root)

scz_gwas_file <- file.path(ref_dir, "SCZ_GWAS_flt_1e-6_R.8.tab.gz")
stopifnot(file.exists(scz_gwas_file))
scz_gwas <- fread(scz_gwas_file)
missing_gwas_cols <- setdiff(c("variant_id", "p"), names(scz_gwas))
if (length(missing_gwas_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required SCZ GWAS columns: ", paste(missing_gwas_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

gwas_set <- unique(scz_gwas[p < 5e-8 & !is.na(variant_id), variant_id])
gwas1e6_set <- unique(scz_gwas[!is.na(variant_id), variant_id])

## DEG support uses author F-test summaries; the author txt list validates the union.
context_order <- names(SEURAT_CONTEXT_TO_DATASET_ID)
split_order <- c("all", "male", "female")

stopifnot(length(unique(manifest$dataset_id)) == nrow(manifest))
stopifnot(all(manifest$dataset_id %in% names(degs$by_dataset_id)))

manifest <- manifest[order(match(split, split_order), match(context, context_order))]
manifest
```

```{r helpers}
required_map_cis_cols <- c("phenotype_id", "variant_id", "qval")
required_indep_cols <- c("phenotype_id", "variant_id", "rank", "pval_perm")

read_map_cis <- function(dataset_id) {
  rel_path <- file.path("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "tqtl_out",
                        paste0(dataset_id, ".gene.map_cis.tab.gz"))
  abs_path <- file.path(repo_root, rel_path)

  if (!file.exists(abs_path)) {
    return(list(
      status = "missing_map_cis",
      rel_path = NA_character_,
      dt = NULL
    ))
  }

  dt <- fread(abs_path)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_map_cis_cols, names(dt))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required columns in ", rel_path, ": ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  list(
    status = "ok",
    rel_path = rel_path,
    dt = dt
  )
}

read_map_independent <- function(dataset_id) {
  rel_path <- file.path("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "tqtl_out",
                        paste0(dataset_id, ".gene.map_independent.txt.gz"))
  abs_path <- file.path(repo_root, rel_path)

  if (!file.exists(abs_path)) {
    return(list(
      status = "missing_map_independent",
      rel_path = NA_character_,
      dt = NULL
    ))
  }

  dt <- fread(abs_path)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_indep_cols, names(dt))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required columns in ", rel_path, ": ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  list(
    status = "ok",
    rel_path = rel_path,
    dt = dt
  )
}

collapse_egenes <- function(dt) {
  unique(dt[, .(gene_id = phenotype_id)])
}

collapse_gene_list <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(unique(x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)]))
  if (length(x) == 0) "" else paste(x, collapse = ", ")
}

tag_eqtl_results <- function(dt, dataset_id, context, split, deg_dt) {
  out <- copy(dt)
  deg_gene_ids <- unique(as.data.table(deg_dt)$gene_id)

  out[, `:=`(
    dataset_id = dataset_id,
    context = context,
    split = split,
    gene_id = phenotype_id,
    gene_name = g2sym[phenotype_id],
    dge = as.integer(phenotype_id %chin% deg_gene_ids),
    gwas = as.integer(variant_id %chin% gwas_set),
    gwas_1e6 = as.integer(variant_id %chin% gwas1e6_set)
  )]

  out[]
}

complete_summary_grid <- function() {
  CJ(
    split = split_order,
    context = context_order,
    unique = TRUE
  )
}

summarize_tagged_eqtls <- function(dt) {
  if (nrow(dt) == 0) {
    out <- complete_summary_grid()
    out[, `:=`(
      n_eGenes = 0L,
      n_GWAS = 0L,
      n_GWAS_1e6 = 0L,
      n_DEG = 0L,
      n_DEG_GWAS = 0L,
      GWAS = "",
      DEGS = "",
      DEG_GWAS = ""
    )]
    return(out)
  }

  obs <- dt[, .(
    n_eGenes = uniqueN(phenotype_id),
    n_GWAS = uniqueN(phenotype_id[gwas == 1]),
    n_GWAS_1e6 = uniqueN(phenotype_id[gwas_1e6 == 1]),
    n_DEG = uniqueN(gene_id[dge == 1]),
    n_DEG_GWAS = uniqueN(phenotype_id[dge == 1 & gwas == 1]),
    GWAS = collapse_gene_list(gene_name[gwas == 1]),
    DEGS = collapse_gene_list(gene_name[dge == 1]),
    DEG_GWAS = collapse_gene_list(gene_name[dge == 1 & gwas == 1])
  ), by = .(split, context)]

  out <- merge(complete_summary_grid(), obs, by = c("split", "context"), all.x = TRUE)
  count_cols <- c("n_eGenes", "n_GWAS", "n_GWAS_1e6", "n_DEG", "n_DEG_GWAS")
  text_cols <- c("GWAS", "DEGS", "DEG_GWAS")
  for (col in count_cols) set(out, which(is.na(out[[col]])), col, 0L)
  for (col in text_cols) set(out, which(is.na(out[[col]])), col, "")
  out[order(match(split, split_order), match(context, context_order))]
}

summarize_independent_signals <- function(dt) {
  if (nrow(dt) == 0) return(summarize_tagged_eqtls(dt))

  obs <- dt[, .(
    n_eGenes = .N,
    n_GWAS = sum(gwas == 1),
    n_GWAS_1e6 = sum(gwas_1e6 == 1),
    n_DEG = uniqueN(gene_id[dge == 1]),
    n_DEG_GWAS = sum(dge == 1 & gwas == 1),
    GWAS = collapse_gene_list(gene_name[gwas == 1]),
    DEGS = collapse_gene_list(gene_name[dge == 1]),
    DEG_GWAS = collapse_gene_list(gene_name[dge == 1 & gwas == 1])
  ), by = .(split, context)]

  out <- merge(complete_summary_grid(), obs, by = c("split", "context"), all.x = TRUE)
  count_cols <- c("n_eGenes", "n_GWAS", "n_GWAS_1e6", "n_DEG", "n_DEG_GWAS")
  text_cols <- c("GWAS", "DEGS", "DEG_GWAS")
  for (col in count_cols) set(out, which(is.na(out[[col]])), col, 0L)
  for (col in text_cols) set(out, which(is.na(out[[col]])), col, "")
  out[order(match(split, split_order), match(context, context_order))]
}

summarize_eqtl_deg_views <- function(eqtl_dt, signal_count = FALSE) {
  view_dt <- as.data.table(degs$views$long)
  view_dt <- view_dt[, .(
    deg_view, context, split, deg_sex, gene_id,
    deg_gene_name = gene_name
  )]

  view_counts <- view_dt[, .(
    n_DEG_reference = uniqueN(gene_id)
  ), by = .(deg_view, context, split, deg_sex)]

  template <- merge(
    manifest[, .(dataset_id, context, split)],
    view_counts,
    by = c("context", "split"),
    all.x = FALSE,
    all.y = TRUE,
    allow.cartesian = TRUE
  )

  totals <- eqtl_dt[, .(
    n_eQTL_records = .N,
    n_eGenes = if (signal_count) .N else uniqueN(phenotype_id),
    n_GWAS = if (signal_count) sum(gwas == 1) else uniqueN(phenotype_id[gwas == 1]),
    n_GWAS_1e6 = if (signal_count) sum(gwas_1e6 == 1) else uniqueN(phenotype_id[gwas_1e6 == 1])
  ), by = .(dataset_id, context, split)]

  overlap_dt <- merge(
    eqtl_dt,
    view_dt,
    by = c("context", "split", "gene_id"),
    all = FALSE,
    allow.cartesian = TRUE
  )

  overlaps <- overlap_dt[, .(
    n_eGene_DEG_overlap = uniqueN(gene_id),
    n_DEG_GWAS = if (signal_count) sum(gwas == 1) else uniqueN(gene_id[gwas == 1]),
    eGene_DEG_overlap_gene_ids = collapse_gene_list(gene_id),
    eGene_DEG_overlap_gene_names = collapse_gene_list(deg_gene_name),
    DEG_GWAS = collapse_gene_list(deg_gene_name[gwas == 1])
  ), by = .(dataset_id, context, split, deg_view, deg_sex)]

  out <- merge(template, totals, by = c("dataset_id", "context", "split"), all.x = TRUE)
  out <- merge(
    out,
    overlaps,
    by = c("dataset_id", "context", "split", "deg_view", "deg_sex"),
    all.x = TRUE
  )

  count_cols <- c(
    "n_eQTL_records", "n_eGenes", "n_GWAS", "n_GWAS_1e6",
    "n_eGene_DEG_overlap", "n_DEG_GWAS"
  )
  text_cols <- c("eGene_DEG_overlap_gene_ids", "eGene_DEG_overlap_gene_names", "DEG_GWAS")
  for (col in count_cols) set(out, which(is.na(out[[col]])), col, 0L)
  for (col in text_cols) set(out, which(is.na(out[[col]])), col, "")

  view_order <- c(
    "broad_interaction",
    "context_localized",
    "sex_specific",
    "context_and_sex_specific"
  )
  out[order(
    match(split, split_order),
    match(context, context_order),
    match(deg_view, view_order),
    deg_sex
  )]
}

eqtl_barchart <- function(mapsum, indep = FALSE) {
  dt <- copy(mapsum)
  dt[, context := factor(context, levels = context_order)]
  dt[, split := factor(split, levels = split_order)]
  dt[, lab_above := sprintf("GWAS: %d\nDEG: %d\nDEG+GWAS: %d", n_GWAS, n_DEG, n_DEG_GWAS)]
  dt[, y_top := fifelse(n_eGenes > 0, n_eGenes, 0)]

  ytitle <- if (indep) {
    "Total independent cis-eQTL signals"
  } else {
    "eGenes discovered (lead cis-eQTLs, q < 0.05)"
  }
  title <- if (indep) {
    "Independent cis-eQTLs by context and split"
  } else {
    "Lead cis-eQTLs by context and split"
  }

  ggplot(dt, aes(x = context, y = n_eGenes, fill = context)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(y = y_top, label = n_eGenes), vjust = -0.3,
              fontface = "bold", size = 3.1, color = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(y = y_top, label = lab_above), vjust = -1.3,
              color = "black", size = 2.6, lineheight = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~ split, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.32))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ytitle, title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey80")
    )
}

deg_view_barchart <- function(view_summary, title) {
  dt <- copy(view_summary)
  dt[, context := factor(context, levels = context_order)]
  dt[, split := factor(split, levels = split_order)]
  dt[, deg_view_label := fifelse(deg_sex == "all", deg_view, paste(deg_view, deg_sex, sep = ": "))]

  ggplot(dt, aes(x = context, y = n_eGene_DEG_overlap, fill = context)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_eGene_DEG_overlap), vjust = -0.25, size = 2.5) +
    facet_grid(deg_view_label ~ split, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "eGene-DEG overlaps", title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey80")
    )
}

summarize_dataset_counts <- function(dataset_id, context, split, file_info) {
  if (identical(file_info$status, "missing_map_independent")) {
    return(data.table(
      dataset_id = dataset_id,
      context = context,
      split = split,
      status = file_info$status,
      map_independent_file = NA_character_,
      n_independent_signals = NA_integer_,
      n_eGenes = NA_integer_,
      max_rank = NA_integer_,
      lead_variant_count = NA_integer_
    ))
  }

  dt <- file_info$dt
  data.table(
    dataset_id = dataset_id,
    context = context,
    split = split,
    status = file_info$status,
    map_independent_file = file_info$rel_path,
    n_independent_signals = nrow(dt),
    n_eGenes = uniqueN(dt$phenotype_id),
    max_rank = as.integer(max(dt$rank, na.rm = TRUE)),
    lead_variant_count = uniqueN(dt$variant_id)
  )
}

summarize_dataset_overlap <- function(dataset_id, context, split, file_info, deg_dt) {
  n_context_degs <- nrow(deg_dt)

  if (identical(file_info$status, "missing_map_independent")) {
    return(data.table(
      dataset_id = dataset_id,
      context = context,
      split = split,
      status = file_info$status,
      map_independent_file = NA_character_,
      n_independent_signals = NA_integer_,
      n_eGenes = NA_integer_,
      n_context_DEGs = n_context_degs,
      n_eGene_DEG_overlap = NA_integer_,
      eGene_DEG_overlap_gene_ids = NA_character_,
      eGene_DEG_overlap_gene_names = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  dt <- file_info$dt
  egenes <- collapse_egenes(dt)
  overlap_dt <- merge(
    egenes,
    as.data.table(deg_dt),
    by = "gene_id",
    all = FALSE,
    sort = FALSE
  )

  data.table(
    dataset_id = dataset_id,
    context = context,
    split = split,
    status = file_info$status,
    map_independent_file = file_info$rel_path,
    n_independent_signals = nrow(dt),
    n_eGenes = nrow(egenes),
    n_context_DEGs = n_context_degs,
    n_eGene_DEG_overlap = uniqueN(overlap_dt$gene_id),
    eGene_DEG_overlap_gene_ids = collapse_gene_list(overlap_dt$gene_id),
    eGene_DEG_overlap_gene_names = collapse_gene_list(overlap_dt$gene_name)
  )
}
```

```{r summarize-map-independent}
summary_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(manifest)), function(i) {
  row <- manifest[i]
  dataset_id <- row$dataset_id[[1]]
  context <- row$context[[1]]
  split <- row$split[[1]]

  map_cis_info <- read_map_cis(dataset_id)
  indep_info <- read_map_independent(dataset_id)
  deg_dt <- as.data.table(degs$by_dataset_id[[dataset_id]])

  list(
    counts = summarize_dataset_counts(dataset_id, context, split, indep_info),
    overlap = summarize_dataset_overlap(dataset_id, context, split, indep_info, deg_dt),
    map_cis = if (identical(map_cis_info$status, "ok")) {
      tag_eqtl_results(map_cis_info$dt, dataset_id, context, split, deg_dt)
    } else {
      NULL
    },
    independent = if (identical(indep_info$status, "ok")) {
      tag_eqtl_results(indep_info$dt, dataset_id, context, split, deg_dt)
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  )
})

counts_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(summary_rows, `[[`, "counts"), use.names = TRUE)
overlap_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(summary_rows, `[[`, "overlap"), use.names = TRUE)
map_cis_all <- rbindlist(lapply(summary_rows, `[[`, "map_cis"), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
indep_all <- rbindlist(lapply(summary_rows, `[[`, "independent"), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

counts_dt <- counts_dt[order(match(split, split_order), match(context, context_order))]
overlap_dt <- overlap_dt[order(match(split, split_order), match(context, context_order))]

counts_dt
overlap_dt
```

```{r summarize-map-cis-and-gwas}
map_cis_summary <- summarize_tagged_eqtls(map_cis_all[qval < 0.05])

parent_q <- map_cis_all[, .(phenotype_id, dataset_id, qval_parent = qval)]
indep_f <- merge(indep_all, parent_q, by = c("phenotype_id", "dataset_id"), all = FALSE)
indep_f <- indep_f[qval_parent < 0.05 & pval_perm < 0.05]
map_independent_summary <- summarize_independent_signals(indep_f)

map_cis_deg_view_summary <- summarize_eqtl_deg_views(map_cis_all[qval < 0.05])
map_independent_deg_view_summary <- summarize_eqtl_deg_views(indep_f, signal_count = TRUE)
map_independent_deg_view_overlap <- summarize_eqtl_deg_views(indep_all)

map_cis_summary
map_independent_summary
```

```{r write-csvs}
split_to_suffix <- c(all = "all", male = "male", female = "female")

counts_tables <- lapply(names(split_to_suffix), function(split_name) {
  counts_dt[split == split_name]
})
names(counts_tables) <- names(split_to_suffix)

overlap_tables <- lapply(names(split_to_suffix), function(split_name) {
  overlap_dt[split == split_name]
})
names(overlap_tables) <- names(split_to_suffix)

for (split_name in names(split_to_suffix)) {
  suffix <- split_to_suffix[[split_name]]

  fwrite(
    counts_tables[[split_name]],
    file.path(summary_dir, paste0("map_independent_counts_", suffix, ".csv"))
  )
  fwrite(
    overlap_tables[[split_name]],
    file.path(summary_dir, paste0("map_independent_deg_overlap_", suffix, ".csv"))
  )
}

fwrite(map_cis_summary, file.path(summary_dir, "map_cis_summary.csv"))
fwrite(map_independent_summary, file.path(summary_dir, "map_independent_summary.csv"))
fwrite(map_cis_deg_view_summary, file.path(summary_dir, "map_cis_deg_view_summary.csv"))
fwrite(map_independent_deg_view_summary, file.path(summary_dir, "map_independent_deg_view_summary.csv"))
fwrite(map_independent_deg_view_overlap, file.path(summary_dir, "map_independent_deg_view_overlap.csv"))

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(summary_dir, "map_cis_summary_barchart.pdf"),
  plot = eqtl_barchart(map_cis_summary, indep = FALSE),
  width = 11,
  height = 12
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(summary_dir, "map_independent_summary_barchart.pdf"),
  plot = eqtl_barchart(map_independent_summary, indep = TRUE),
  width = 11,
  height = 12
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(summary_dir, "map_cis_deg_view_summary_barchart.pdf"),
  plot = deg_view_barchart(map_cis_deg_view_summary, "map-cis DEG-view overlaps"),
  width = 14,
  height = 14
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(summary_dir, "map_independent_deg_view_summary_barchart.pdf"),
  plot = deg_view_barchart(map_independent_deg_view_summary, "independent signal DEG-view overlaps"),
  width = 14,
  height = 14
)

list.files(summary_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = FALSE)
```
